title: Precision Golden-Probe Orchestrator for FP8/INT8 Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an automated, experiment-first validation harness (the Golden-Probe Orchestrator) to gate FP8/INT8 rollouts. The orchestrator will stitch together: curated golden prompt cohorts, calibration capture + replay, deterministic stochastic-replay (multi-seed) runs, metric computation (embedding cosine, token-level KL, top-k exact match, hallucination rate heuristics), and staged pass/fail gates with statistical tests. Outputs drive canary decisions and generate per-model, per-layer sensitivity reports for the runtime teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Golden cohort runner can execute 10k prompts across 3 seeds within CI and upload raw outputs to S3. 2) Metric suite computes per-prompt deltas (cosine/ROUGE/top-k) and aggregates with confidence intervals. 3) Gate config supports per-metric thresholds and rollback triggers for dedicated and hosted deployments. 4) Dashboard tile with per-model gate status + diff visualizations available in Console by release candidate. 5) End-to-end test in pipeline that fails a PR if critical metric regression > configured threshold.
work_notes: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting — aligned on scope, golden prompt curation strategy (mix of unit, edge-case, and production-sampled prompts). Action: design schema for golden metadata (intent, expected patterns, origin).
2026-03-11: Prototype runner implemented that replays cached KV prefixes and records model logits; initial run on small fp8 candidate shows mean cosine drop 0.9% on dev set (sample n=500).

2026-03-12: Added multi-seed stochastic replay (3 seeds) and bootstrap CI comparator. Early failure mode: variance on long-context summarization prompts high; flagged as "context sensitivity" cohort for further calibration.

2026-03-13: Review with ML researchers — decided to add per-layer activation histogram capture for the first 4 transformer blocks to surface quantization hot spots. Jonah to open PR for activation-collector shim (github.com/redwood/rt/PR-4521).
Risks: Storing logits for 10k prompts multiplies storage and telemetry costs — plan to compress diffs and TTL raw logs to 30 days for non-enterprise.
next_steps: Finish PR for activation-collector shim and land unit tests (blocked by internal infra quota until 2026-03-15).
Formalize gate thresholds: run A/B on historical rollout data to pick default thresholds, then expose overrides per-customer tier. (Owner: Jonah)
Integrate harness with CI: add workflow that triggers full golden-run for runtime release branches and posts results to /ci/quant-gate. (Owner: CI team)
Create Console dashboard spec and link to telemetry instrumentation ticket (file: confluence.redwood/sec/quant-gate-spec).
qa_steps: Run harness against baseline (fp16) and candidate (int8) and verify that computed deltas match offline notebook reference within epsilon=1e-4.
Inject synthetic regression on small cohort to validate fail-fast gate behavior in CI.
Run end-to-end canary rollout in Dedicated staging with rollback policy enabled and confirm telemetry triggers.
notes_for_pm: PM should prepare customer communication templates for cases where gate blocks a public rollout; recommend two-tier messaging (internal incident + customer-facing advisory) and escalation path to SRE. Also decide default gating strictness for Enterprise customers.
